changeSummary: Replace session-by-session coordination with one user-facing Marketing Chief and canonical state.
lesson: Dillon should not have to discover, prompt, or reconcile routine worker tasks; the Chief owns delegation and state reconciliation.

changeSummary: Use the persistent authenticated remote Chrome session for authorized browser-dependent client and Google account work; never use Edge unless explicitly overridden.
lesson: Reuse the authorized Chrome session and non-secret credential locator. Never store or reveal the password, cookie, token, or code, and pause for human-only authentication gates.

changeSummary: Quarantine substring, cross-client, bot-recipient, and possibly completed matches instead of executing them.
lesson: Only exact active registry identity plus a current requested outcome can trigger execution; ambiguity and stale state remain quarantined.

changeSummary: Treat Bitwarden as the canonical vault and do not stop at a password screen before checking the approved vault route.
lesson: Resolve exact Bitwarden entry metadata and attempt authorized autofill, passwordless, or passkey access in persistent Chrome; retain only opaque locators and keep MFA, one-time codes, recovery, and consent as human handoffs.

changeSummary: Consolidate marketing coordination into one pinned Marketing Chief task and one canonical client-operations project.
lesson: Routine sensors and internal workers must not create user-facing tasks. Archive redundant automation-generated tasks after safe consolidation, preserve their history, and surface at most one human decision.

changeSummary: Replace repeated prompting with explicit next-action ranking, channel voice retrieval, rendered design QA, and accept-modify-defer-reject feedback.
lesson: Instructions alone do not create prediction, voice, or taste. Rank current evidence, retrieve client and channel context, inspect rendered outputs, and record redacted decision and edit deltas so future work changes.
A styled registration page alone did not satisfy the requested prototype outcome.
replacementRule: For webinar prototype requests, include a functioning attendee flow and an operator-side simulation with consent-safe calendar actions, configuration, measurement, and verification before reporting completion.

lesson: The first deployed workshop page failed because it used a generic visual system and omitted Momentum 360 brand assets.
replacementRule: For Momentum 360 landing pages, start from the established M360 Orbit visual language and exact corporate logo. Preserve navy, gold, cyan, Space Grotesk, DM Sans, command-console framing, and proof badges while excluding any reference motif the user rejects.
